errorBody: Your information has not changed. Please try again.

evidenceHelp.shown: You showed it, for example with a document or something you did
evidenceHelp.inferred: PAI worked this out from your conversation; you have not said or shown it
evidenceHelp.question: Two answers disagree; PAI will ask you which one is right

heatmapLegend: Colour shows how strong the evidence is. Dots show how much there is. This is never a score.
